name: Nerfbusters
definition: A 3D diffusion-based method that improves scene geometry and reduces floaters in casually captured NeRFs by leveraging local 3D priors and a novel density-based score distillation sampling loss.
summary: Nerfbusters is a 3D diffusion-based regularization method that improves NeRF geometry and removes floaters by applying a local 3D geometric prior learned from synthetic patches.
